title: Field Shirt
description: A relaxed everyday shirt in a crisp cotton weave, cut to layer without feeling oversized.
details: Relaxed fit, curved hem, corozo buttons and two practical chest pockets.
care: Machine wash cold with similar colours. Hang dry.

title: Wide Trouser
description: A clean wide-leg trouser with a soft drape and a considered high rise.
details: High rise, wide leg, concealed hook closure and side pockets.
care: Dry clean recommended. Steam to refresh.

title: Studio Knit
description: A fine-gauge knit designed as an easy first layer or clean standalone piece.
details: Regular fit, ribbed collar and cuffs, fine merino blend.

title: Everyday Tee
description: A substantial cotton tee with a clean neck and enough structure to hold its shape.
details: Relaxed fit, 220gsm organic cotton, reinforced neck binding.
care: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low.

title: Utility Jacket
description: A lightly structured jacket with generous pockets and an easy straight silhouette.
details: Water-resistant cotton blend, four external pockets and adjustable cuffs.

title: Column Skirt
description: A fluid midi skirt with a clean waist and subtle back split for movement.
details: Midi length, elasticated back waist and concealed side zip.

title: Canvas Cap
description: A six-panel cotton canvas cap with an understated embroidered mark.
details: Unstructured six-panel shape with adjustable back strap.
care: Spot clean with a damp cloth.

title: Relaxed Overshirt
description: A midweight overshirt with a soft hand and room for a fine knit underneath.
details: Relaxed fit, patch pockets and brushed cotton twill.
